name: DEEP × Arcsweep Science Spine Bridge

hierarchy.note: This bridge operates beneath Universal Horizon. Hearthfire, Flameclyffe, Arcsweep, and Yggdrasil remain distinct systems connected through an optional, reversible adapter.

description: Binds DEEP visual state, PREMAQ/environment observations, mathematical derivations, graph context, and an Arcsweep Notion world anchor into one provenance-preserving packet. Optionally supplies the packet to Yggdrasil as named operational context without altering identity or upgrading interpretation into measurement.
standaloneInterface: HTTP — GET /health, GET /worlds, GET /latest, POST /bind, POST /yggdrasil

sourceLaw.flameclyffe: DEEP mathematical, observer, and sensory source implementation
sourceLaw.hearthfire: Standalone bridge runtime and append-only packet ledger
sourceLaw.yggdrasil: Interpreter, router, witness, and world-structure reader; never source rewriter

disconnectBehaviour: DEEP, Arcsweep, Yggdrasil, and Hearthfire continue independently. Hosts report the bridge offline rather than impersonating a live connection.
